label: AOPs applicable to an NCBI taxon
description: Lists the AOPs whose taxonomic applicability (ncbitaxon:131567) is a given NCBI Taxonomy id, with the names AOP-Wiki uses for that taxon. Match the taxon IRI directly: since November 2026 the common-species terms (WCS_9606 and similar) are written as NCBITaxon IRIs too. Applicability given as free text (user-created terms such as mammals) is a plain string and is not matched; see the free-text example for those. The graph has no taxonomic hierarchy, so a query for Mammalia does not return AOPs for human or rat.
